integrity: Independent direct C++ quartic-character and Python connection-set bit-mask enumerations agree; exact finite-field representations and exhaustive symmetry ranges are supplied.
scientific_limitations: Finite first-order graph-language comparison at orders 121 and 361 and sharp minimum eligible Peisert order only; no all-larger-orders theorem. Historical priority remains qualified because the full text of Kisielewicz–Peisert (2004) was not accessible.
title: A sharp rank-five Paley–Peisert separation and the first 4-existentially closed Peisert graph
